name: Disarm
description:
For your Action make an Opposed Melee/Melee Test. If succeeded, the following can happen:
0 - 1 SL: Opponent loses weapon which flies 1d10 feet in random direction
2- 3 SL: As above, but you determine the distance
4 - 5 SL: YOu also determine the direction
6+ SL: You may chose to take opponent's weapon if you have a free hand
This Talent cannot be used against opponents with no weapons, or with Size larger than you.

name: Blather
description:
Rapidly talking nonsense without letting other interrupt you. 
Lets you attempt Opposed Charm/Intelligence Test. Success gives 1 Stunned Condition for each level of Blather.
If you stop talking, the affected person loses all Stunned Conditions right away. You attempt this one per person.

name: Schemer
description: Once per session you, you may take a secret Intelligence Test to get information about a political situation or entangled web of social connections. GM will provide you the information based on your SL.

name: Embezzle
description:
When Earning (during play or performing Income Endeavour), if you have an  employer, you can do a Opposed Intelligence Test. If you win gain 2d10 + SL brass pennies, 1d10 + SL silver shillings, or 1 + SL gold
crowns (depending on the size of the business). If your employer wins by 6+ SL, you still gain the money but you are detected.

name: Riposte
description: If your weapon has the Fast quality, you can do Damage when being attacked. During a Round, you can riposte number of attack equal you the level of Riposte Talent.

name: Nose for Trouble
description:
An Intuition Test allows you to spot other trying to stir up trouble or hurt you. If potential troublemakers are trying to conceal their intentions, this Test is Opposed. The GM may take this Test  on your behalf so you might not know if it succeeded or not.
If the detected troublemakers start combat, you do not get a Surprised Condition.

name: Relentless
description: The advantage cost of the Flee from Harm action is reduced to 1.

name: Gunner
description: Add level of this Talent to SL of any Extended Test to reload a Blackpowder weapon. Reloading a ranged weapon in combat now counts as Assess action. Gain +1 Advantage when making Assess Test to Reload.

name: Second Sight
tests: Any Test to detect the Winds of Magic
description: You perceive  Winds of Magic and its influence with all your senses.

name: Sixth Sense
tests: Intuition Tests involving your Sixth Sense
description: If you are approaching a dangerous situation, GM may take a secret Intuition Test for you. If successful, your GM will warn you and you don't get Surprised condition when attacked.

name: Etiquette - Guilder - Engineer
description: Allows to act like you belong among Engineer Guilders.

name: Etiquette - Servants
description: Allows to act like you belong among Servants.

name: Arcane Magic - Beasts
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Beasts.

name: Arcane Magic - Shadow
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Shadow.

name: Stone Soup
description: You are remarkable at resisting hunger. You can survive on half of normal amount of food without any penalties. In addition, when starving, you need to test for Starvation every 3 days instead of every 2.

name: Invoke - Ulric
description: You may now empower miracles of Ulric - God of War.

name: Etiquette - Guilder
description: Allows to act like you belong among members of a guild.

name: Holy Hatred
description: Gain +1 Damage with Miracles for each level of this Holy Hatred.

name: Feint
description: You can Feint for you Action against an opponent using a weapon.  If you win Opposed Melee (Fencing)/Melee Test and perform attack before the end of the next Round, add your Feint SL to the attack roll.

name: Hunter's Eye
tests: Any Test to trail or capture game
description:
When in rural area, you are automatically able to hunt enough game to feed yourself and number of others equal the level of this Talent (given time and equipment).
You can get additional food using normal foraging rules.

name: Fisherman
description:
When in proximity of a large body of water, you are automatically able to fish enough to feed yourself and number of others equal the level of this Talent (given time and equipment).
 You can get additional food using normal foraging rules.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Whenever you are a target of a spell (positive or negative) the SL of any spell affecting you is reduced by 2 per level of Magic Resistance. The SL is reduced by the highest Magic Resistance in the area. You cannot learn the following Talents: Arcane Magic, Bless, Invoke, Petty Magic, and Witch!.

name: Savant
description: You Know a number of pieces of information equal to level of this Talent about the associated Lore without taking the Lore Skill Test.

name: Craftsman - Explosives
description: Add the Trade - Explosives Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Explosives, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Invoke - Taal
description: You may now empower miracles of Taal - God of the Wild.

name: Acute Sense - Hearing
description: Allows to take Perception Test to detect barely detectable sounds or tone differences.

name: Battle Rage
description: Battle Rage lets you attempt to end Frenzy state at the end of each round (Cool Test).

name: Dealmaker
description: Reduce or increase prices by an extra 10% when Haggling.

name: Accurate Shot
description: Add Accurate Shot level to Damage with all ranged weapons.

name: Cat-tongued
description: When lying using Charm, opponents cannot use Intuition to detect that you are lying.

name: Criminal
description:
When Earning or during Income Endeavour add the following per Talent level:
Career Level 1, +2d10 bp
Career Level 2, +1d10 ss
Career Level 3, +2d10 ss
Career Level 4, +1 gc
You have visible signs you are a criminal, and others without Criminal Talent consider you lower Status.
Authorities are always suspicious of you (increasingly with the level of this Talent).
GM can agree to remove levels of this Talent for the same XP it cost to buy.

name: Frightening
description: If you wish, you have a Fear Rating equal to the level of Frightening.

name: Magical Sense
description: You attempt an Average (+20%) Intuition Test to sense the Winds of Magic in others. Scoring an Astounding Success (+6) reveals target's highest Channeling Specialization.

name: Break and Enter
tests: Melee when forcing or breaking inanimate objects
description: Add +1 Damage for each level of This Talent when damaging inanimate objects.

name: Fast Hands
tests: Sleight of Hand, Melee (Brawling) to touch an opponent
description:
Others can only Oppose your Sleight of Hand Test (with Perception) if they suspect you and are actively looking for your movements.
If you use your Melee (Brawling) to touch an opponent, you get a bonus of +10 times the level of Fast Hands.

name: Catfall
description: When falling you take a Athletics Test. If succeeded, Reduce the distance fallen by 1 + SL yards when calculating Damage.

name: Crack the Whip
tests: Drive or Ride Tests when Fleeing or Running
description: When Fleeing or Running using an animal, add +1 Movement to it.

name: Attractive
tests: Charm Tests to influence those attracted to you
description: After successfully using Charm on those attracted to you, you may chose to use the number on the unit die as the SL of the Charm Test.

name: Warrior Born
description: Permanent +5 bonus to Weapon Skill Characteristic (WS) that does not count towards Advances.

name: Magnum Opus
description: Every time you take this Talent, you can create an unique piece of art with one of you Art or  Trade Skills. Such item will be an extraordinary achievement in its class an will provide bonus to Fellowship Tests from people that know you made it. It will have 10 times or more of its usual value.

name: Savant - Local
description: You know a number of pieces of information equal to the level of this Talent about the  chosen Local area without taking the Lore - Local Test.

name: Strider - Woodlands
description: Ignore all movement penalties when moving through Woodlands.

name: Craftsman - Apothecary
description: Add the Trade - Apothecary Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Apothecary, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Hatred - Greenskins
description:
On encountering a member of Greenskins, you must attempt a Psychology Test. If failed you are subject to Hatred. You can attempt Psychology Test at the end of every subsequent Round to stop the Hatred.
While subject to Hatred, you must attack the Greenskins. You gain +1 SL to all combat Tests versus them and you are immune to Fear and Intimidate (but not Terror) caused by the Greenskins.

name: Etiquette - Nobles
description: Allows to act like you belong among Nobles.

name: Arcane Magic
description: You may memorise spells from your chosen Lore. The XP cost of memorising a new spell depends on the number of spell already known: new spell cost = round down("number of spells known" / "Int Bonus" + 1) * 100 XP. Normally you cannot learn more than one Arcane Magic Lore.  Having this Talent also prevents you from having Bless and Invoke Talents. You can unlearn Arcane Magic for 100 XP but you will lose all spells.

name: Arcane Magic - Witchcraft
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Witchcraft.

name: Etiquette - Guilder - River Pilot
description: Allows to act like you belong among River Pilot Guilders.

name: Strider - Marshes
description: Ignore all movement penalties when moving through Marshes.

name: Wealthy
description: When Earning (during play or performing Income Endeavours) gain +1 gold crown per level of Wealthy.

name: Strike to Injure
description: When rolling on a Critical Damage table, make two rolls and choose which result you prefer.

name: Robust
description: Reduce Damage taken by +1 for each level of  this Talent. Damage can only be reduced to 1 (you always take at least 1 Damage).

name: Strong-minded
description: Increase your maximum Resolve pool by the level of this Talent.

name: Strong Back
description: Add the level of this Talent to SL in any Opposed Strength Test. In addition, you can carry extra points of Encumbrance equal to the level of Strong Back.

name: Sturdy
description: You can carry extra points of Encumbrance equal to twice the level of Sturdy.

name: Perfect Pitch
tests: Entertain (Sing), Language (Tonal Languages, such as Eltharin, Cathayan, and Magick)
description:
You can perfectly identify and reproduce any tones or notes  without attempting a Test. 
Add the Entertain - Sing to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade Skill, you can obtain the Skill for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Carouser
tests: Charm at Parties, Gossip at Parties, Consume Alcohol
description: If you fail a Consume Alcohol Test, you may reverse the die roll if that lets you succeed.

name: Old Salt
description: Ignore all penalties when Testing Sail using sea vessels. You count as two, towards the minimum required number of crew members to operate a sea ship.

name: Strike Mighty Blow
description: Add the level of Strike Mighty Blow to all Damage made with melee weapons.

name: Etiquette - Guilder - Apothecary
description: Allows to act like you belong among Apothecary Guilders.

name: Master Tradesman - Poisoner
description: Lets you reduce required SL of any Extended Test using your Trade - Poisoner Skill by the level of your Master Tradesman - Poisoner Talent.

name: Impassioned Zeal
tests: Charm when speaking about your cause
description: If you are talking about your cause or religion, double your Fellowship when determining the number of influenced people by your Public Speaking.

name: Drilled
tests: Melee Tests when beside an ally with Drilled
description: Characters with the Drilled Talent count as two when determining Losing Advantage.

name: Bless - Sigmar
description: You can deploy Blessings of Sigmar - God of The Empire.

name: Holy Visions
tests: Intuition Tests when on holy ground
description: You automatically know when you enter Holy Ground. You may take an Intuition Test to receive visions regarding significant past events that occurred there.

name: Craftsman - Boatbuilder
description: Add the Trade - Boatbuilder Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Boatbuilder, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: War Wizard
description: On your Turn, you can cast any  known spell with Casting Number 5 or less without using your Action. If you do, you cannot cast another spell this Turn (but you can perform other actions).

name: Fearless - Heretics
tests: Cool to oppose Heretic's Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Heretics.

name: Sharp
description: Permanent +5 bonus to Initiative Characteristic (I) that does not count towards Advances.

name: Sure Shot
description: When using ranged weapon, ignore opponent's APs equal to the level of Sure Shot.

name: Lip Reading
description: If see someone's lips, you can take a Perception Test to make out what they are saying.

name: Etiquette - Scholar
description: Allows to act like you belong among Scholars.

name: Fearless - Witches
tests: Cool to oppose Witch’s Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Witches.

name: Craftsman - Engineer
description: Add the Trade - Engineer Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Engineer, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Bless - Taal
description: You can deploy Blessings of Taal - God of the Wild.

name: Invoke - Verena
description: You may now empower miracles of Verena - Goddess of Wisdom.

name: Cardsharp
tests: Gamble and Sleight of Hand when playing card games
description:
If you achieve Success in Gamble or Sleight of Hand Test playing card games, you may chose to use your unit die roll to determine Test's SL.
If you play real card games to represent in-game games, you get extra number of cards (per deal) equal your Cardship level, then you discard any cards so that your hand-size remains the same.

name: Craftsman - Herbalist
description: Add the Trade - Herbalist Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Herbalist, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Etiquette - Guilder - Artisan
description: Allows to act like you belong among Artisan Guilders.

name: Berserk Charge
tests: Melee on a Round when you Charge
description: Gain +1 Damage to all Melee attacks per level of Berserk Charge when Charging.

name: Bookish
description: When testing your Research skill, you can reverse the dice of any failed test if this will score a success.

name: Iron Will
description: Prevents Intimidate Skill form causing Fear in you.

name: Combat Reflexes
description: When determining Combat Initiative, gain +10 for each level of Combat Reflexes.

name: Pure Soul
description: You may gain extra Corruption points equal to the level of this Talent before having to Test to see if you become corrupt.

name: Sea Legs
tests: All those taken to resist Sea Sickness
description:
You are resistant to sea sickness.
Under regular conditions at sea, you do not need a Test to resist Sea Sickness.
Under special circumstances, you can ignore all penalties to Tests to resist Sea Sickness.

name: Kingpin
description: You do not suffer Status penalties from the Criminal Talent.

name: Scale Sheer Surface
description: Ignore any penalties to Climb Tests coming from the difficulty of the surface climbed.

name: Strong Legs
description: When jumping, add the level of Strong Legs to your SL in Athletics Test.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: Permanent +5 bonus to Agility Characteristic (Ag) that does not count towards Advances.

name: Mimic
tests: Entertain (Acting) Tests where accents are important
description: Given a day of exposure, you can take an Initiative Test to learn an accent of a Language you already know. If failed, you can retake the Test once per day. If succeeded, you permanently know how to reproduce the accent.

name: Public Speaker
description:
When publicly speaking to a crowd of people, you can influence many more people with your Charm Skill than usual. Level 1 - As normal x 5
Level 2 - As normal x 10
Level 3 - As normal x 20
Level 4 - As normal x 50
Level 5 - As normal x 100
Level 6 - As normal x 200
Level 7 - As normal x 500
Level 8 - As normal x 1000
Level 9 - Everyone you can reach with your voice

name: Iron Jaw
description: Whenever you are about to get a Stunned Condition, you can take a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test. Success allows you to ignore the Condition. Each SL lets you remove 1 extra Stunned Condition.

name: Fearless
tests: Cool to oppose your Enemy's Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from a particular type of Enemy.

name: Fearless - Road Wardens
tests: Cool to oppose Road Warden’s Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Road Wardens.

name: Argumentative
tests: Charm Tests when arguing and debating
description: If you achieve Success in Charm Test to debate or argue, you may chose to use your unit die roll to determine Test's SL.

name: Strider - Rocky
tests: Athletics Tests to traverse Rocky terrain
description: Ignore all movement penalties when moving through Rocky terrain.

name: Bless - Morr
description: You can deploy Blessings of Morr - God of Death.

name: Invoke - Manann
description: You may now empower miracles of Manann - God of The Sea.

name: Master Tradesman - Herbalist
description: Lets you reduce required SL of any Extended Test using your Trade - Herbalist Skill by the level of your Master Tradesman  - Herbalist Talent.

name: Luck
description: Maximum Fortune Points are increased by the level of Luck Talent.

name: Beat Blade
description: For your Action, you can choose to Beat Blade before rolling. Perform a Melee Test, if successful, the opposing Advantage Pool loses  1 Advantage, and loses a further 1 if you score 6 SL. This Test is not Opposed. This Talent is of no use if your opponent has no weapon, or has a larger Size than you.

name: Menacing
description: When using the Intimidate Skill, add +1 SL for each level of this Talent.

name: Rover
tests: Stealth Tests in a Rural environment
description: When using Stealth - Rural, others do not get a Perception Test to detect you, unless they are specifically looking for you.

name: Strike to Stun
tests: Melee Tests when Striking to Stun
description: You ignore the ‘Called Shot’ penalty to strike the Head Hit Location when using melee Pummel weapons. All improvised weapons you use have now Pummel Quality.

name: Roughrider
description: When fighting mounted, If you have Ride Skill, you can take an Action without a Ride Test. For the purpose of resisting Fear and Terror caused by the size of your opponent, your size is the same as the size of your mount.

name: Trick Riding
description:
You can use Perform and Dodge Skills while mounted without any penalties.
In combat, you can Move at the beginning of the Round (outside of normal Initiative order).

name: Inspiring
description:
When at war, you can use Leadership to inspire many more of you subordinate soldiers than usual.
Level 1 - As normal x 5
Level 2 - As normal x 10
Level 3 - As normal x 20
Level 4 - As normal x 50
Level 5 - As normal x 100
Level 6 - As normal x 200
Level 7 - As normal x 500
Level 8 - As normal x 1000
Level 9 - Everyone you can reach with your voice

name: Secret Identity
tests: Entertain (Acting) Tests to support your secret identities
description:
You have one or more (equal to the level of this Talent) secret identities. Each identity has a Career associated with it. While posing as your secret identity you can use that identity's Social Status for Fellowship Tests. It lets you ignore Criminal Talent if you have one.
It requires  Entertain - Acting Test every time you interact with someone that can see through your act.

name: Resistance
description: Pass automatically the first test against associated threat. The SL of such test is your TB.

name: Fearless - Wreckers
tests: Cool to oppose Wrecker’s Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Wreckers.

name: Master Orator
description: Add level of Master Orator to SL of any successful Charm Test when Public Speaking.

name: Arcane Magic - Metal
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Metal.

name: Arcane Magic - Life
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Life.

name: Arcane Magic - Hedgecraft
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Hedgecraft.

name: Fearless - Criminals
tests: Cool to oppose Criminal's Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Criminals.

name: Savant - Theology
description: You know a number of pieces of information equal to the level of this Talent about the Theology without taking the Lore - Theology Skill Test.

name: Bless - Myrmidia
description: You can deploy Blessings of Myrmidia - Goddess of Strategy.

name: Bless - Rhya
description: You can deploy Blessings of Rhya - Goddess of Fertility.

name: Invoke - Rhya
description: You may now empower miracles of Rhya - Goddess of Fertility.

name: Fleet Footed
description: Permanently gain +1 to Movement.

name: Hatred - Outlaws
description:
On encountering a member of Outlaws, you must attempt a Psychology Test. If failed you are subject to Hatred. You can attempt Psychology Test at the end of every subsequent Round to stop the Hatred.
While subject to Hatred, you must attack the Outlaws. You gain +1 SL to all combat Tests versus them and you are immune to Fear and Intimidate (but not Terror) caused by the Outlaws.

name: Coolheaded
description: Permanent +5 bonus to Willpower Characteristic (WP) that does not count towards Advances.

name: Numismatics
tests: Evaluate to establish the worth of coins
description: Allows you to evaluate value of a coin without a Test. You can detect forged coin with a Simple Evaluate Test instead of Opposed by the SL of the Forger.

name: Commanding Presence
description: Anyone with lower Status cannot resist your Leadership Test with their Willpower.

name: Master of Disguise
description: You may pretend to be someone else without having to use a Disguise Kit.

name: Shieldsman
tests: Any Test to defend with a shield
description: When using a shield to defend, once per turn, you may spend 2 Advantage to either cause Damage when you are attacked as if it were your Action or to push your opponent 2 yards directly back from yourself and no longer count as engaged.

name: Strider
description: Ignore all movement penalties when moving in the specified terrain.

name: Hatred
description:
On encountering a member of Hatred group, you must attempt a Psychology Test. If failed you are subject to Hatred. You can attempt Psychology Test at the end of every subsequent Round to stop the Hatred.
While subject to Hatred, you must attack the hated group members. You gain +1 SL to all combat Tests versus that group and you are immune to Fear and Intimidate (but not Terror) caused by them.

name: Acute Sense - Taste
description: Allows to take Perception Test to detect barely detectable tastes.

name: Master Tradesman - Apothecary
description: Lets you reduce required SL of any Extended Test using your Trade - Apothecary Skill by the level of your Master Tradesman - Apothecary Talent.

name: Savant - Apothecary
description: You know a number of pieces of information equal to the level of this Talent about the Apothecary without taking the Lore - Apothecary Skill Test.

name: Resistance - Poison
description: Pass automatically the first test against poison. The SL of such test is your TB.

name: Sprinter
description: When determining your running speed, increase your Movement by 1.

name: Fearless - Bounties
tests: Cool to oppose Bounty's Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Bounties.

name: Diceman
tests: Gamble and Sleight of Hand when playing dice games
description:
If you achieve Success in Gamble or Sleight of Hand Test playing dice games, you may chose to use your unit die roll to determine Test's SL.
If you are using real-life dice games to represent in-game games, always roll extra number of rolls equal to the level of Diceman, and chose the best results.

name: Arcane Magic - Heavens
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Heavens.

name: Arcane Magic - Necromancy
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Necromancy.

name: Fearless - Outlaws
tests: Cool to oppose Outlaw's Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Outlaws.

name: Bless - Shallya
description: You can deploy Blessings of Shallya - Goddess of Mercy.

name: Field Dressing
description: If you fail a Heal Test, you may reverse the die roll if that lets you succeed. In such case, your SL is capped at +1.

name: Invoke - Shallya
description: You may now empower miracles of Shallya - Goddess of Mercy.

name: Savant - Herbs
description: You know a number of pieces of information equal to the level of this Talent about the Herbs without taking the Lore - Herbs Skill Test.

name: Fearless - Riverwardens
tests: Cool to oppose Riverwarden's Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Riverwardens.

name: Read/Write
description: You can read and write (if appropriate) all of the Languages you can speak.

name: Suave
description: Permanent +5 bonus to Fellowship Characteristic (Fel) that does not count towards Advances.

name: Reversal
description: If you win an Opposed Melee Test, instead of gaining +1 Advantage, you may chose to remove 1 Advantage from the opposing Advantage Pool and add it to your own. In that case, you do not cause any Damage, even if it is your Turn.

name: Hardy
description: Permanently add your Toughness Bonus (TB) to your Wounds. The extra Wounds increase if  your TB increases.

name: Sharpshooter
description: When using ranged weapons, ignore any Difficulty modifiers due to the size of the target.

name: Resolute
description: When Charging, add level of Resolute to your Strength Bonus.

name: Linguistics
description:
When exposed to a new Language for at least a month, you may take an Intelligence Test. If successful, you can use this Language as a Basic Skill. This Test can be attempted once a month. 
Linguistics applies only to regular Languages, not to professional ones (such as Battle or Magick).

name: Super Numerate
description: You have a gift for mathematics. That include solving complex problems and doing exceptional in-memory calculations.

name: Rapid Reload
description: Add level of this Talent to SL of any Reload Tests of a ranged weapon. Reloading a ranged weapon in combat now counts as Assess action. Gain +1 Advantage when making Assess Test to Reload.

name: Furious Assault
description: Once per Round, if you successfully hit your opponent in close combat, you can spend Advantage or Move to make an extra attack.

name: Etiquette - Criminal
description: Allows to act like you belong among Criminals.

name: Etiquette - Guilder - Boatmen
description: Allows to act like you belong among Boatbuilder Guilders.

name: Jump Up
description: Anytime you gain a Prone Condition, you may take a Challenging (+0) Athletics Test to imminently stand back up. This Test is modified by +/- 10 for every 10 points of Strength the blow has over/under your Toughness.

name: Stout-hearted
tests: Cool Tests to remove Broken Conditions
description: In addition to usual rules, You can take an extra Cool Test to remove Broken Condition at the end of each Round.

name: Enclosed Fighter
description: You may ignore all penalties to Melee Tests due to fighting is tight spaces. You can use your Dodge Skill in enclosed small spaces where you normally wouldn't be allowed to sue it.

name: Arcane Magic - Daemonology
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Demonology.

name: Savant - Medicine
description: You know a number of pieces of information equal to the level of this Talent about the Medicine without taking the Lore - Medicine Skill Test.

name: Frenzy
description:
After a successful Willpower Test, you can go Frenzy.
You become immune to all psychology and cannot flee or retreat. Each round you must either attack or move at full speed towards a target. You can only take Weapon Skill or Athletics (to reach the opponent) Tests. Each round you have an extra Free Action Melee Test and +1 Strength Bonus. You remain in the state of Frenzy until all opponents are dead (or appear dead) or you get Stunned or Unconscious Conditions. After Frenzy is over, you get Fatigued Condition.

name: Small
description: Your size is Small instead of Average.

name: Shadow
description:
You can follow someone secretly (Shadowing) without taking a combined Combined Perception and Stealth Test (Opposed with target's Stealth Skill if the target is trying to lose the tail).
Instead, you may take a Perception or Stealth Skill Test (whichever is higher). This Test is also Opposed with target's Stealth Skill if the target is trying to lose the tail

name: Gregarious
description: If you fail a Gossip Test, you may reverse the die roll if that gives you Success.

name: Unshakeable
tests: Cool Tests to resist Blackpowder panic
description: When shoot at with a Blackpowder weapon, you have to take a Cool Test to avoid Broken Condition only if you are wounded.

name: Dirty Fighting
description:
You can chose to fight dirty in a fist fight: add +1 Damage for each level of Dirty Fighting to any successful Melee - Brawling hit.
Use of this Talent in any formal fight will be considered cheating.

name: Implacable
description: You ignore Wounds from Bleeding Condition. Each level of Implacable lets you ignore Wounds from an extra Bleeding Condition.

name: Tunnel Rat
description: When using Stealth - Underground, others do not get a Perception Test to detect you, unless they are specifically looking for you.

name: Resistance - Disease
description: Pass automatically the first test against disease. The SL of such test is your TB.

name: Arcane Magic - Light
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Light.

name: Bless
description: You can cast Blessings of one of the Divine Lores. Normally, you can know only one Divine Lore.

name: Bless - Ranald
description: You can deploy Blessings of Ranald - God of Trickery.

description: You can deploy Blessings of Verena - Goddess of Wisdom.

name: Dual Wielder

You can Attack with your both hands for you Action. You perform main hand attack as normal. If the main hand attack hits, you may attack with second hand any available target. 

If the main hand roll was NOT A CRITICAL, for secondary hand attack hit roll use the first one but reversed (for example, from 34 to 43). 
If the main hand attack WAS A CRITICAL, for your second attack use your Critical Table roll.

Damage of the second attack is calculated as normal. Secondary hand attack Test also suffers -20 penalty unless you have Ambidextrous Talent.

When you attack with both weapons, all your defensive rolls take -10 penalty until you next Turn. Unless both attacks hit, you do not gain an Advantage.

name: Reaction Strike

name: Hatred - Followers of Manann
description:
On encountering Followers of Manann, you must attempt a Psychology Test. If failed you are subject to Hatred. You can attempt Psychology Test at the end of every subsequent Round to stop the Hatred.
While subject to Hatred, you must attack the follower. You gain +1 SL to all combat Tests versus them and you are immune to Fear and Intimidate (but not Terror) caused by them.

name: Hatred - Followers of Manann or Chaos
description: Hatred of either Followers of Manann or Chaos.

name: Craftsman - Farmer
description: Add the Trade - Farmer Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Farmer, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Craftsman - Cook
description: Add the Trade - Cook Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Cook, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Etiquette - Burghers
description: Allows to act like you belong among Burghers.

name: Arcane Magic - Beasts or Heavens
description: You may memorise spells from your chosen Lore.

name: Disciple of Change
description: Every time you gain a mutation, roll twice and chose one result.

name: Double Life
description: You are a master of living a double life. In addition to your Chaos Career, you can have another Career from which you can purchase Skills, Talents, etc.

name: Tzeentch's Blessing
description: You may purchase one Colour Magic spell for 100 XP for every spell you have memorised from the Lore of Tzeentch.

name: Suffused With Magic
description: All successful spell casts (within WP yards) receive +1 SL. This bonus applies only once, even if there are multiple people with Suffused with Magic in the vicinity.

name: Savant - Tzeentch
description: You know a number of pieces of information equal to the level of this Talent about Tzeentch without taking the Lore - Tzeentch Skill Test.

name: Chaos Magic - Undivided
description: You may instantly learn any of the spells from: Arcane Spells and Chaos Arcane Spells. You also gain 1 corruption point. Each level of this talent always costs 100 XP.

name: Wilful Corruption
description: Every time you gain a mutation, roll twice and chose one result.

name: Dual Wielder or Shieldsman
description: You posses Dual Wielder or Shieldsman talent.

name: Etiquette - Beastmen
description: Allows get along and be friendly with Beastmen.

name: Arcane Magic - Tzeentch
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Tzeentch.

name: Controlled Corruption
tests: Endurance to avoid gaining a mutation
description:
Endurance Tests to avoid gaining a mutation are Difficult (-10)
instead of Challenging (+0), but when you gain a mutation, roll
twice and choose from the two results.

name: Extra Spell
description: Each rank of Extra Spell Talent gives you access to a single spell from the Lore of Slaanesh.

name: Arcane Magic - Slaanesh
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Slaanesh.

name: Arcane Magic - Ruin
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Ruin. This talent can by taken only by Skavens.

name: Arcane Magic - Plague
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Plague. This talent can by taken only by Skavens.

name: Arcane Magic - Stealth
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Stealth. This talent can by taken only by Skavens.

name: Tail Fighting
tests: Any Melee Test involving a Tail weapon
description: You can use your tail for anything that requires a hand. In fight, you can make 1 extra attack with a Tail Weapon every round.

name: Arcane Magic - Little Waaagh!
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of Little Waaagh!

name: Blessed by Isha
description: Only Elves can learn this Talent. It allows the character to take the High Magic Talent.

name: High Magic
description: Only Elves can learn this Talent. Requires Blessed by Isha Talent and Channelling - Qhaysh Skill. Allows you to cast High Magic Spells. Every time you gain rank of High Magic, you learn a new High Magic Spell.

name: Arcane Magic - WAAAGH!
description: You may now memorise spells from The Lore of WAAAGH!

name: Cantor
description: You can use Entertain - Sing instead of Channeling when performing a Channelling Test. Any user within Fel yards can siphon off a single SL from your Extended Channelling Test per round. You can also perform Entertain - Sing Test specifically to help another wizard's Channelling Test even if you cannot cast spells yourself.

name: Ancestral Grudge
description:
Every time you take this Talent, select a faction (Orcs, Goblins, Skaven, etc.). The become target of your vengeance. Every time you win a significant victory against that group you gain 50 XP.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Bludgeoner
tests: Strength Tests when activating Pummel Quality
description:
After activating the Pummel Quality, you inflict an additional Stunned Condition for each level this Talent.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Demolisher
tests: Melee when breaking inanimate objects using a Hack weapon
description:
When attacking using weapon with Hack quality reduce enemy cover by 1 level (hard to medium, etc.). After activating Hack, gain + 1 Damage on struck armour or shields for each level of this Talent.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Dragon Belcher
description:
When firing Blackpowder weapon, enemies who fail Cool Test gain 1 extra Broken Condition for each level of this Talent.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Entrenchment
description:
When in soft cover, attacks against you are Hard (-20) instead of Difficult (-10). When in medium cover, attacks are Very Hard (-30) instead of Hard (-20).
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Forgefire
description:
When Engaged, you and allies within WP Bonus yards gain Penetrating Quality. If an affected weapon is already Penetrating, its attacks now ignore 1 additional point of non-metal armour. 
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Glorious Demise
description:
After receiving Unconscious Condition, you can  immediately make a Melee attack as a Free Action, before you are taken out of action.
In case of Stunned Condition, you can spend a Fortune point to do it.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Harpooner
description:
When inflicting a Critical Hit with a Crossbow weapon, add +10 per Talent rank to Critical Hit table roll, up to a maximum of 100. Crossbow bolts lodged in due to Impale Quality, reduce target's Movement by 1 per bolt, to a minimum of 1.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Kingsguard
description:
Any enemy attacks against an ally within 2 yards of you suffers a -10 modifier for each level of Kingsguard. Talent has no effect if you are currently suffering from a Condition.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Liquid Fortification
description:
Gain +10 to S and T after consuming alcoholic drink that lasts 1 hour. Drinking more, prolongs the effect but does not increase Characteristics above +10.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Long Memory
description:
You never forget anything. You can perfectly recall time, date, location, and  faces etc. See detailed description in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Magic Defiance
tests: Willpower Tests to use Magic Resistance
description:
You can Reverse any Test you need to make as part of a spell’s effects, as well as Tests to dispel magic with Magic Resistance.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Master Rune Magic
description:
Lets you create master runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Maverick
tests: Sail - Skycraft Tests to fly fast and dangerous
description:
You do not suffer the -20 penalty on Ranged attacks when using the Flight Creature Trait.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Rune Magic
description:
Lets you create runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Short Fuse
description:
Gain +1 Rating per level of this Talent when using weapons with Blast Quality.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Tireless
description:
When calculating penalties due to Fatigued Condition, reduce number of Fatigued Conditions by the total level of Tireless.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Underminer
description:
Do not suffer penalties for attacking while having Prone Condition or being beneath the opponent. Enemies do not get a bonus to attack you whilst you have the Prone Condition. Gain extra +20 to hit Surprised enemies when emerging from a tunnel, pit, or other hidden position below them.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Whirlwind of Death
description:
For 1 Fortune point, you can attack all engaged opponents at the same time. The GM chooses one enemy to Oppose this Test. If your attack succeeds, you inflict the same Damage to the same Hit Location to all enemies.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Craftsman - Brewer
description: Add the Trade - Brewer Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Brewer, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Master Tradesman - Brewer
description: Lets you reduce required SL of any Extended Test using your Trade - Brewer Skill by the level of your Master Tradesman - Brewer Talent.

name: Master Tradesman - Cook
description: Lets you reduce required SL of any Extended Test using your Trade - Cook Skill by the level of your Master Tradesman - Cook Talent.

name: Rune Magic - Protection Runes
description:
Lets you create protection runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Fearless - All
tests: Cool to oppose Animal’s Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from any enemy.

name: Rune Magic - Weapon Runes
description:
Lets you create weapon runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Master Rune Magic - Protection and Weapon Runes
description:
Lets you create master weapon and protection runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Rune Magic - Armour and Engineering Runes
description:
Lets you create armour and engineering runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Rune Magic - Protection and Talismanic Runes
description:
Lets you create protection and talismanic runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Master Rune Magic - Protection Runes
description:
Lets you create master protection runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Master Rune Magic - Talismanic Runes
description:
Lets you create master talismanic runes. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Rune Magic - Rune of Stone
description:
Lets you create Rune of Stone. Detailed rules in Dwarf Player's Guide p. 82.
Unique to Dwarf Characters.

name: Etiquette - Ranaldans
description: Allows to act like you belong among worshippers of Ranald.

name: Invoke - The Night Prowler
description: You may now empower miracles of The Night Prowler - aspect of Ranald.

name: Invoke - The Gamester
description: You may now empower miracles of The Gamester - aspect of Ranald.

name: Invoke - The Deceiver
description: You may now empower miracles of The Deceiver - aspect of Ranald.

name: Invoke - The Protector
description: You may now empower miracles of The Protector - aspect of Ranald.

name: Craftsman - Art
description: Add the Trade - Art Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade - Art, you can obtain it for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Craftsman - Blacksmith or Art
description: Add the associated Trade Skill to any Career you enter. If the Career already has that Trade Skill, you can obtain the Skill for 5 XP fewer per Advance.

name: Etiquette - Guilder - Muleskinner
description: Allows to act like you belong among Muleskinner Guilders.

name: Lileath's Blessing
description:
For each rank of this Talnet, add +1 SL to any Channelling - Qhaysh Test.
Each level of Lileath's Blessing, allows the caster to cast an additional aura spell (High Magic or Colour Magic) even when they already have another Ward-granting spell cast.

name: Blood of Aenarion
description:
Available for High Elves only. You are a descendant of the first phoenix king. 
You gain 1 Fate Point. At the end of each week you must pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or gain the Yenlui - Dark Psychology Trait.
You also gain either Magical or Martial Prodigy and a Mental Mutation.
See High Elf Player's Guide p. 51 for details.

name: Mind over Body
description:
Available to Elf spellcasters. After passing a Challenging (+0) Pray Test gain the following benefits for  1d10 + SL x d10 hours:
* 1 level: Gain Painless Creature  and do not receive Conditions caused by pain.
* 2 level: Gain divine sight (see details in High Elf Player's Guide p. 101).
* 3 level: You can use Resolve to ignore Critical Would penalties on Extended Tests.

name: Cadai Meditation
description: Available to High Elves only. Each day, if you pass an Average (+20) Pray Test, you can adjust your Yenlui State to Light.

name: Eye of the Storm
description:
Available to Elf spellcasters. After passing a Challenging (+0) Pray Test gain the following benefits for  1d10 + SL x d10 hours:
* 1 level: Immunity to distractions that can interrupt Channelling
* 2 level: Recover from Fatigued Conditions in half the normal time and ignore ignore penalties from them to Casting and Channelling Tests
* 3 level: When rolling on a Weather table you may modify the result of each die by +/- 1

name: Martial Arts
description: You Unarmed attacks lose Undamaging Flaw. For each subsequent level, you can use one of the following Qualities unarmed: Damaging, Defensive, Distract, Fast, Penetrating, Precise, Pummel. When combat begins or one of your Turns starts, choose one Quality to use until your next Turn.

name: Sanctuary of the Mind
description:
Available to Elf spellcasters. After passing a Challenging (+0) Pray Test gain the following benefits for  1d10 + SL x d10 hours:
* 1 level: Immunity to Corruption resulting from spellcasting
* 2 level: +1 SL to any Research Tests
* 3 level: Exemption from the negative modifiers resulting from Yenlui States

name: Sword-dancing
description:
Available to High Elves. Allows you to perform various sword-dancing techniques that use a Greatsword.
You learn Ritual of Cleansing technique. You may learn additional techniques (High Elf Player's Guide p. 68-69) for 100 XP times the number of techniques you already know.

name: Uncouth Uranai
description: When interacting with High Elves from Caledor, Ellyrion, Avelorn, or Saphery, reduce Standing by 1.

name: Savant - Oceans
description: You know a number of pieces of information equal to the level of this Talent about the Oceans without taking the Lore - Oceans Skill Test.

name: Fearless - Dark Elves
tests: Cool to oppose Dark Elf's Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Dark Elves.

name: Fearless - Sea Monsters
tests: Cool to oppose Sea Monsters's Intimidate, Fear, and Terror
description: If you successfully pass an Average (+20%) Cool Test you can ignore any Intimidate, Fear, or Terror effects from Sea Monsters.

name: Arcane Magic - Wind of Magic
description: You may memorise spells from your chosen Lore. The XP cost of memorising a new spell depends on the number of spell already known: new spell cost = round down("number of spells known" / "Int Bonus" + 1) * 100 XP. Normally you cannot learn more than one Arcane Magic Lore.  Having this Talent also prevents you from having Bless and Invoke Talents. You can unlearn Arcane Magic for 100 XP but you will lose all spells.

name: Savant - Magic
description: You know a number of pieces of information equal to the level of this Talent about the Magic without taking the Lore - Magic Test.

name: Master Tradesman - Blacksmith
description: Lets you reduce required SL of any Extended Test using your Trade - Blacksmith Skill by the level of your Master Tradesman - Blacksmith Talent.

name: Hatred - Dark Elves
description:
On encountering Dark Elves creature, you must attempt a Psychology Test. If failed you are subject to Hatred. You can attempt Psychology Test at the end of every subsequent Round to stop the Hatred.
While subject to Hatred, you must attack the Dark Elf. You gain +1 SL to all combat Tests versus them and you are immune to Fear and Intimidate (but not Terror) caused by them.
